title.zh: 卷403 列傳一百九十 胜保 托明阿 陈金绶 德兴阿
title.en: Volume 403 Biographies 190: Sheng Bao, Tuo Ming A, Chen Jinshou, De Xing A
title.raw: 卷403 列傳一百九十 胜保 托明阿 陈金绶 德兴阿

sentences.zh: 勝保，字克齋，蘇完瓜爾佳氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao, courtesy name Kezhai, of the Suwan Guwalgiya clan, was a man of the Bordered White Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao, styled Kezhai, belonged to the Suwan Guwalgiya clan of the Manchu Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 道光二十年舉人，考授順天府教授。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Daoguang he passed the provincial examination and, through examination, was appointed professor of Shuntian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Daoguang (1840) he earned his juren degree and, on examination, was appointed professor of Shuntian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遷贊善，大考二等，擢侍講，累遷祭酒。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be a tutor in the Eastern Palace, rated second class in the grand examination, promoted to reader-in-waiting, and repeatedly advanced to grand master of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to the post of palace tutor, placed in the second class in the triennial evaluation, promoted to reader-in-waiting, and eventually rose to grand master of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 屢上疏言事，甚著風采。

translations.literal: He repeatedly submitted memorials on affairs of state and greatly distinguished himself by his forthrightness.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized the throne repeatedly on public affairs and won wide notice for his bold, outspoken manner.

sentences.zh: 歷光祿寺卿、內閣學士。

translations.literal: He served successively as minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and as a grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He held the posts of minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat in turn.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，因天變上疏論時政，言甚切直，略謂：「廣西賊勢猖獗，廣東、湖南皆可憂。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, citing a celestial portent, he submitted a memorial on current affairs in very blunt language, stating in summary: 'The bandits in Guangxi are rampant, and both Guangdong and Hunan are cause for concern.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng (1852), citing a celestial omen, he submitted a blunt memorial on current affairs. In essence he wrote: 'The rebels in Guangxi are raging out of control, and both Guangdong and Hunan are deeply worrisome.

sentences.zh: 賽尚阿督師無功，請明賞罰以振紀綱。

translations.literal: Saišangga commands the army without success; please make rewards and punishments clear to restore discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Saišangga has achieved nothing as commander-in-chief; rewards and punishments should be made explicit to restore discipline.

sentences.zh: 河決不治河員之罪，刑輕盜風日熾，應明敕法以肅典常。

translations.literal: When the river breaks its banks the river officials' crimes go unpunished; penalties are light and banditry grows daily fiercer—the law should be clearly enforced to uphold proper standards.
translations.idiomatic: When dikes burst, the river officials go unpunished; because punishments are too light, banditry grows fiercer by the day. The law ought to be enforced clearly to uphold proper standards.

sentences.zh: 臣工奏摺多留中，恐滋流弊。

translations.literal: Many memorials from officials are kept at court without response, which may breed lasting abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Too many officials' memorials are held at court without reply, a practice that may breed lasting abuses.

sentences.zh: 一切事務，硃批多而諭旨少。

translations.literal: On all matters there are many vermilion endorsements but few imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On all affairs there are many vermilion endorsements but few formal imperial edicts.

sentences.zh: 市井細民，時​​或私論聖德。」

translations.literal: Among the common people in the marketplaces, there are at times private discussions of the emperor's virtue.'
translations.idiomatic: Even common townspeople sometimes whisper privately about the emperor's virtue.'

sentences.zh: 疏入，下樞臣傳問疏末兩端，令直言無隱。

translations.literal: When the memorial was received, it was sent down to the grand councillors to question him on the two points at the end of the memorial, ordering him to speak frankly without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the grand councillors were instructed to question him about the two points raised at the end and to speak frankly without holding anything back.

sentences.zh: 覆奏曰：「硃批因事垂訓，臣工奉到遵行，他人不與聞，非若諭旨頒示天下。

translations.literal: In his reply he stated: 'Vermilion endorsements offer instruction on particular matters; officials receive them and obey, but others do not hear of them, unlike edicts that are promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In reply he wrote: 'Vermilion endorsements instruct on particular matters; officials receive them and obey, but others never hear of them, unlike edicts that are promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 近日諸臣條奏雖依議，而原奏之人不知；

translations.literal: Recently, although memorials from various officials were acted on according to deliberation, the original memorialists did not know the outcome;
translations.idiomatic: Recently, although officials' memorials were decided according to deliberation, the original memorialists were not told the outcome;

sentences.zh: 交部重案，覆奏依議，外人並不知作何發落。

translations.literal: in major cases referred to the ministries, when the reply came back with approval of the deliberation, outsiders likewise did not know what disposition was made.
translations.idiomatic: and in major cases referred to the ministries, when the reply came back with approval of the deliberation, outsiders still had no idea what disposition had been made.

sentences.zh: 古者象魏懸書，俾眾屬目。

translations.literal: In antiquity edicts were posted on the watchtower so that all might fix their eyes upon them.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity edicts were posted on the public tower so that all could see them.

sentences.zh: 似宜通行宣示，以昭朝廷之令甲，而杜胥吏之蔽欺。

translations.literal: It would seem fitting to promulgate them generally, to make clear the court's commands and to stop clerks and subordinates from concealing and deceiving.
translations.idiomatic: It would seem better to promulgate them broadly, to make the court's commands clear and to stop clerks and subordinates from concealing and deceiving.

sentences.zh: 至愚賤私議，或謂皇上勵精之心不如初政，或謂勤儉之德不及先皇。

translations.literal: As for the private talk of the foolish and lowly, some say the emperor's resolve to exert himself is not what it was at the beginning of his reign, or that his diligence and frugality do not match those of the late emperor.
translations.idiomatic: As for the private talk of common people, some say the emperor's resolve to govern diligently is not what it was at the start of his reign, or that his diligence and frugality do not match those of the late emperor.

sentences.zh: 今遊觀之所，煥然一新。

translations.literal: Now the places of sightseeing have been made wholly new.
translations.idiomatic: Now the imperial pleasure grounds have been made wholly new.

sentences.zh: 釋服之後，必將有適性陶情之事，現在內府已有採辦犁園服飾以備進御者。

translations.literal: After the mourning garb is laid aside, there will surely be pursuits to suit one's nature and cultivate the feelings; already within the palace workshops costumes for the opera garden are being procured in readiness for presentation to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: After the mourning period ends, there will surely be pastimes for pleasure and diversion; already the palace workshops are procuring opera costumes in readiness for the emperor's use.

sentences.zh: 夫鼓樂田獵，何損聖德。

translations.literal: Music, drums, and hunting—what harm do they do to sagely virtue?
translations.idiomatic: Music, drums, and hunting—what harm could they do to sagely virtue?

sentences.zh: 然自古帝王必先天下之憂而憂，後天下之樂而樂。

translations.literal: Yet from antiquity emperors have first shared the realm's worries and only afterward shared the realm's joys.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from antiquity emperors have first shared the realm's worries and only afterward shared its joys.

sentences.zh: 書曰：'無於水監，當於民監。

translations.literal: The Book says: 'Do not take the water as your mirror; take the people as your mirror.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Documents says: 'Do not take water as your mirror; take the people as your mirror.

sentences.zh: '誠不可不察也。」

translations.literal: Truly this cannot but be examined.'
translations.idiomatic: This truly cannot but be heeded.'

sentences.zh: 文宗不懌，明諭指駁，以其意存諷諫，不之罪也。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong was displeased and issued an explicit edict rebutting him, but because his intent was admonitory he was not punished.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong was displeased and issued an explicit edict rebutting him, but because his intent was admonitory he was not punished.

sentences.zh: 尋因自行撤回封奏，降四品京堂。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, because he had on his own withdrawn a sealed memorial, he was demoted to a fourth-rank capital official.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, because he had on his own withdrawn a sealed memorial, he was demoted to a fourth-rank capital official.

sentences.zh: 會粵匪犯武昌，勝保疏陳辦賊方略，命馳往河南，交欽差大臣琦善差遣。

translations.literal: When the Cantonese bandits attacked Wuchang, Sheng Bao submitted a memorial setting forth strategy for dealing with the bandits; he was ordered to hasten to Henan and placed under the orders of the imperial commissioner Qishan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taiping rebels attacked Wuchang, Sheng Bao submitted a memorial outlining strategy against them. He was ordered to hurry to Henan and placed under the imperial commissioner Qishan.

sentences.zh: 三年春，偕提督陳金綬率兵援湖北、安徽，而江寧告急。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year he joined the provincial commander Chen Jinshou in leading troops to aid Hubei and Anhui, but Jiangning reported urgent danger.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year (1853) he joined provincial commander Chen Jinshou in leading troops to aid Hubei and Anhui, but Jiangning sent urgent appeals for help.

sentences.zh: 至則城已陷，駐兵江浦。

translations.literal: When he arrived the city had already fallen, and he encamped his troops at Jiangpu.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived the city had already fallen, and he encamped his troops at Jiangpu.

sentences.zh: 勝保疏陳軍事稱旨，命以內閣學士會辦軍務，克浦口而賊陷揚州，偕陳金綬進剿。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao's memorial on military affairs pleased the throne; he was ordered, as grand secretary, to assist in military affairs. He captured Pukou, but the bandits took Yangzhou, and he joined Chen Jinshou in advancing to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao's memorial on military affairs pleased the throne; he was ordered, as grand secretary, to assist in military affairs. He captured Pukou, but the rebels then took Yangzhou, and he joined Chen Jinshou in advancing to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 擊賊鎮海寺南，破之，薄揚州城下，賜花翎。

translations.literal: He attacked the bandits south of Zhenhai Temple, defeated them, and pressed close beneath Yangzhou city; he was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked the rebels south of Zhenhai Temple, routed them, and pressed close beneath Yangzhou city, for which he was granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 又連破賊於天寧、廣儲門外。

translations.literal: He again repeatedly defeated the bandits outside Tianning and Guangchu Gates.
translations.idiomatic: He again defeated the rebels in succession outside Tianning and Guangchu Gates.

sentences.zh: 奉命赴安徽勦賊，而賊已入河南，渡河圍懷慶。

translations.literal: Ordered to go to Anhui to exterminate the bandits, he found they had already entered Henan, crossed the river, and besieged Huaqing.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to go to Anhui to exterminate the rebels, he found they had already entered Henan, crossed the Yellow River, and besieged Huaqing.

sentences.zh: 勝保會諸軍進擊，將軍托明阿軍其東，勝保軍其南。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao joined the various armies in advancing to attack; General Tuo Ming'a encamped on the east and Sheng Bao on the south.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao joined the various armies in advancing to attack; General Tuo Ming'a encamped on the east and Sheng Bao on the south.

sentences.zh: 時督師大學士訥爾經額遙駐臨洺關，援軍數路久頓城下，惟二軍戰較力，命勝保幫辦河北軍務。

translations.literal: At the time the commanding grand secretary Ne'erjing'e remained far off at Linming Pass; relief forces on several routes had long halted beneath the city walls, and only these two armies fought with real effort. Sheng Bao was ordered to assist in Hebei military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the commanding grand secretary Ne'erjing'e remained far off at Linming Pass; relief forces on several routes had long stalled beneath the city walls, and only these two armies fought with real vigor. Sheng Bao was ordered to assist in Hebei military affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月，分三路進攻賊壘，大破之，懷慶圍解，加都統銜，賜黃馬褂，予霍鑾巴圖魯名號。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he divided his forces into three routes to attack the bandit stockades and inflicted a great defeat; the siege of Huaqing was lifted. He was given the rank of lieutenant general, granted the yellow riding jacket, and awarded the title of Holian Batūru.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he divided his forces into three routes, stormed the rebel stockades, and won a great victory, lifting the siege of Huaqing. He was given the rank of lieutenant general, granted the yellow riding jacket, and awarded the title of Holian Batūru.

sentences.zh: 賊竄山西，連陷數縣，諸軍遷延，惟勝保率善祿、西凌阿兵四千尾追，一破之封門山口，再破之平陽，繞出賊前，扼韓侯嶺，尋复洪洞、平陽。

translations.literal: The bandits fled into Shanxi and in succession took several counties; the various armies delayed, but Sheng Bao alone led four thousand troops under Shanlu and Xiling'a in pursuit. He defeated them once at Fengmen Pass, again at Pingyang, swung ahead of the bandits, and held Hanhou Ridge; soon afterward he recovered Hongdong and Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled into Shanxi and in succession took several counties; the various armies delayed, but Sheng Bao alone led four thousand troops under Shanlu and Xiling'a in pursuit. He defeated them once at Fengmen Pass and again at Pingyang, swung ahead of the rebels, and held Hanhou Ridge; soon afterward he recovered Hongdong and Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 劾逗留諸將托雲保、董占元、烏勒欣泰等，罪之；

translations.literal: He impeached the delaying generals Tuoyunbao, Dong Zhanyuan, Wulexintai, and others and had them punished;
translations.idiomatic: He impeached the delaying generals Tuoyunbao, Dong Zhanyuan, Wulexintai, and others and had them punished;

sentences.zh: 詔嘉勝保果勇有為，授欽差大臣，代訥爾經額督師，節制各路，特賜康熙朝安親王所進神雀刀，凡貽誤軍情者，副將以下立斬以聞。

translations.literal: An edict praised Sheng Bao as resolute, brave, and capable; he was appointed imperial commissioner in place of Ne'erjing'e as commander-in-chief with authority over all routes. He was specially granted the divine sparrow blade presented by Prince An in the Kangxi reign, and anyone who caused military failure below the rank of brigade commander was to be immediately beheaded and reported.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Sheng Bao as resolute, brave, and capable; he was appointed imperial commissioner in place of Ne'erjing'e as commander-in-chief with authority over all routes. He was specially granted the divine sparrow blade presented by Prince An in the Kangxi reign, and anyone who caused military failure below the rank of brigade commander was to be immediately beheaded and reported.

sentences.zh: 賊既不得北竄，轉而南，由澤、潞間道入直隸境。

translations.literal: The bandits, unable to flee north, turned south and entered Zhili by the bypaths between Ze and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to flee north, the rebels turned south and entered Zhili by the bypaths between Ze and Lu.

sentences.zh: 訥爾經額師潰於臨洺關，賊复猖獗，竄順德、趙州、正定。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e's army collapsed at Linming Pass; the bandits again grew rampant and fled through Shunde, Zhaozhou, and Zhengding.
translations.idiomatic: Ne'erjing'e's army collapsed at Linming Pass; the rebels again grew rampant and fled through Shunde, Zhaozhou, and Zhengding.

sentences.zh: 勝保由井陘一路迎截，坐追賊不力，鐫二級。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao intercepted them by the Jingxing route and, on the charge of pursuing the bandits without vigor, was stripped of two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao intercepted them by the Jingxing route and, on the charge of pursuing the rebels without vigor, was stripped of two ranks.

sentences.zh: 命惠親王綿愉為大將軍，科爾沁郡王僧格林沁為參贊大臣，駐軍涿州，直隸軍務仍責勝保專任，而以西凌阿、善祿副之。

translations.literal: Prince Hui Mianyu was appointed grand general and the Khorchin prince Sengge Rinchen assistant commander; they encamped at Zhuozhou. Zhili military affairs were still entrusted solely to Sheng Bao, with Xiling'a and Shanlu as his deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Hui Mianyu was appointed grand general and the Khorchin prince Sengge Rinchen assistant commander; they encamped at Zhuozhou. Zhili military affairs were still entrusted solely to Sheng Bao, with Xiling'a and Shanlu as his deputies.

sentences.zh: 賊東竄，由深州、河間窺天津，勝保轉戰追賊至靜海。

translations.literal: The bandits fled east, spying on Tianjin through Shenzhou and Hejian; Sheng Bao fought in turn and pursued the bandits to Jinghai.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled east, threatening Tianjin through Shenzhou and Hejian; Sheng Bao fought in turn and pursued them to Jinghai.

sentences.zh: 賊由獨流分踞楊柳青，迭擊之，遂聚於靜海、獨流，負嵎久踞。

translations.literal: The bandits split from Duliui to occupy Yangliuqing; after repeated attacks they gathered at Jinghai and Duliui and, relying on difficult terrain, held out for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels split from Duliui to occupy Yangliuqing; after repeated attacks they gathered at Jinghai and Duliui and, relying on difficult terrain, held out for a long time.

sentences.zh: 詔僧格林沁進軍合剿。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Sengge Rinchen to advance and join in the joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Sengge Rinchen to advance and join in the joint suppression.

sentences.zh: 四年春，賊突圍走阜城，追擊，殲賊數千，陣斃悍酋吉文元。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year the bandits broke out and fled to Fucheng; in pursuit several thousand bandits were destroyed and the fierce chieftain Ji Wenyuan was killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year (1854) the rebels broke out and fled to Fucheng; in pursuit several thousand rebels were destroyed and the fierce chieftain Ji Wenyuan was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 而援賊由江北偷渡黃河擾山東，命勝保移兵往剿，臨清失守，坐褫職，戴罪自效。

translations.literal: Meanwhile relief bandits from north of the Yangzi secretly crossed the Yellow River and harassed Shandong; Sheng Bao was ordered to move his troops to suppress them. When Linqing fell he was stripped of office on that charge and ordered to redeem himself through service.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile relief rebels from north of the Yangzi secretly crossed the Yellow River and harassed Shandong; Sheng Bao was ordered to move his troops to suppress them. When Linqing fell he was stripped of office on that charge and ordered to redeem himself through service.

sentences.zh: 尋破賊，克臨清，餘賊南走，追擊迭破之，解散甚眾。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he defeated the bandits, recovered Linqing, and as the remaining bandits fled south he pursued and repeatedly defeated them, dispersing a great many.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he defeated the rebels, recovered Linqing, and as the remaining rebels fled south he pursued and repeatedly defeated them, dispersing a great many.

sentences.zh: 及竄入豐縣，僅千餘人，蹙之河岸，悉數殲除。

translations.literal: When they fled into Feng County with only a little over a thousand men, he pressed them to the riverbank and destroyed them all.
translations.idiomatic: When they fled into Feng County with only a little over a thousand men, he pressed them to the riverbank and destroyed them all.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，復職，加太子少保。

translations.literal: When victory was reported he was restored to office and given the title Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When victory was reported he was restored to office and given the title Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁圍林鳳祥、李開芳於連鎮，久未下，命勝保回軍會剿。

translations.literal: Sengge Rinchen besieged Lin Fengxiang and Li Kaifang at Lianzhen but for a long time could not take it; Sheng Bao was ordered to return and join in the joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen besieged Lin Fengxiang and Li Kaifang at Lianzhen but for a long time could not take it; Sheng Bao was ordered to return and join in the joint suppression.

sentences.zh: 開芳突出，分股竄山東，勝保親率輕騎追之，賊陷高唐踞守，圍之數月不能克。

translations.literal: Kaifang broke out, split into detachments, and fled into Shandong; Sheng Bao personally led light cavalry in pursuit. The bandits took Gaotang and held it; he besieged it for several months without being able to capture it.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifang broke out, split into detachments, and fled into Shandong; Sheng Bao personally led light cavalry in pursuit. The rebels took Gaotang and held it; he besieged it for several months without being able to capture it.

sentences.zh: 迭詔詰責，褫職逮京治罪，遣戍新疆。

translations.literal: Repeated edicts rebuked and censured him; he was stripped of office, arrested and sent to the capital for punishment, and banished to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated edicts rebuked and censured him; he was stripped of office, arrested and sent to the capital for punishment, and banished to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 直隸、山東賊既平，予藍翎侍衛，充伊犁領隊大臣。

translations.literal: After the bandits in Zhili and Shandong were pacified, he was given the post of blue-feather bodyguard and appointed brigade commander at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels in Zhili and Shandong were pacified, he was given the post of blue-feather bodyguard and appointed brigade commander at Ili.

sentences.zh: 六年，召還，發往安徽軍營差遣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was recalled and sent to the Anhui army camp for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1856) he was recalled and sent to the Anhui army camp for assignment.

sentences.zh: 七年，予副都統銜，幫辦河南軍務。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was given the rank of vice commander and ordered to assist in Henan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1857) he was given the rank of vice commander and ordered to assist in Henan military affairs.

sentences.zh: 捻匪方熾，勝保至，連破之方家集、烏龍集、柳溝集，克三河尖老巢。

translations.literal: The Nian bandits were then at their height; when Sheng Bao arrived he repeatedly defeated them at Fangjiaji, Wulongji, and Liugouji and captured their old stronghold at Sanhejian.
translations.idiomatic: The Nian bandits were then at their height; when Sheng Bao arrived he repeatedly defeated them at Fangjiaji, Wulongji, and Liugouji and captured their old stronghold at Sanhejian.

sentences.zh: 又克河關，复霍丘，大捷於正陽關，斬捻首魏藍奇等，加頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: He again captured Heguan, recovered Huoqiu, and won a great victory at Zhengyang Pass, beheading the Nian chieftain Wei Lanqi and others; he was given the first-class official's button.
translations.idiomatic: He again captured Heguan, recovered Huoqiu, and won a great victory at Zhengyang Pass, beheading the Nian chieftain Wei Lanqi and others; he was given the first-class official's button.

sentences.zh: 八年，平酆家集、喬家廟、趙屯諸捻巢。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he pacified the Nian nests at Fengjiaji, Qiaojiamiao, and Zhaotun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1858) he pacified the Nian nests at Fengjiaji, Qiaojiamiao, and Zhaotun.

sentences.zh: 粵匪大股圍固始，擊破之，殲賊萬餘，斬偽顯天侯卜占魁等，固始圍解。

translations.literal: A large force of Cantonese bandits besieged Gushi; he attacked and defeated them, destroying more than ten thousand bandits and beheading the false Manifest Heaven Marquis Bu Zhan'kui and others; the siege of Gushi was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: A large Taiping force besieged Gushi; he attacked and defeated them, destroying more than ten thousand rebels and beheading the false Manifest Heaven Marquis Bu Zhan'kui and others, lifting the siege of Gushi.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉謀勇兼優，遇都統缺出題奏，复黃馬褂、巴圖魯，免其弟廉保遣戍罪。

translations.literal: An edict praised his combined excellence in planning and courage, ordered that when a lieutenant general's vacancy arose he be recommended, restored his yellow riding jacket and Batūru title, and remitted the banishment sentence of his younger brother Lianbao.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised his combined excellence in planning and courage, ordered that when a lieutenant general's vacancy arose he be recommended, restored his yellow riding jacket and Batūru title, and remitted the banishment sentence of his younger brother Lianbao.

sentences.zh: 粵匪陳玉成、李侍賢合陷廬州、鳳陽，授勝保鑲黃旗蒙古都統，命為欽差大臣，督辦安徽軍務，連破賊於定遠池河、高橋。

translations.literal: The Cantonese bandits Chen Yucheng and Li Shixian together took Luzhou and Fengyang; Sheng Bao was appointed lieutenant general of the Mongol Bordered Yellow Banner, made imperial commissioner, and put in charge of Anhui military affairs; he repeatedly defeated the bandits at Dingyuan Chihe and Gaoqiao.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiping generals Chen Yucheng and Li Shixian together took Luzhou and Fengyang; Sheng Bao was appointed lieutenant general of the Mongol Bordered Yellow Banner, made imperial commissioner, and put in charge of Anhui military affairs; he repeatedly defeated the rebels at Dingyuan Chihe and Gaoqiao.

sentences.zh: 督軍抵三河，賊遁走。

translations.literal: He led the army to Sanhe and the bandits fled.
translations.idiomatic: He led the army to Sanhe and the rebels fled.

sentences.zh: 捻首李兆受久踞江、淮間，與粵匪勾結。

translations.literal: The Nian chieftain Li Zhaoshou had long held the region between the Yangzi and the Huai and was in collusion with the Cantonese bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The Nian chieftain Li Zhaoshou had long held the region between the Yangzi and the Huai and was in collusion with the Taiping rebels.

sentences.zh: 及見粵匪屢挫，漸持兩端。

translations.literal: When he saw the Cantonese bandits repeatedly defeated, he gradually began to waver between the two sides.
translations.idiomatic: When he saw the Taiping rebels repeatedly defeated, he gradually began to waver between the two sides.

sentences.zh: 勝保親至清流關密招之，許歸誠後免罪授官。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao personally went to Qingliuguan to recruit him in secret, promising that after surrender his crimes would be remitted and he would be given office.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao personally went to Qingliuguan to recruit him in secret, promising that after surrender his crimes would be remitted and he would be given office.

sentences.zh: 兆受以其部下家屬在江寧，請緩發。

translations.literal: Zhaoshou, because the families of his subordinates were in Jiangning, asked that the surrender be delayed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoshou, because the families of his subordinates were in Jiangning, asked that the surrender be delayed.

sentences.zh: 至是進攻天長，兆受內應，克之，遂獻滁州，奏授參將職，改名世忠，安置降★，自為一軍。

translations.literal: At this point he advanced to attack Tianchang; Zhaoshou responded from within and it was taken. He then offered up Chuzhou; a memorial was submitted appointing him regimental commander, changing his name to Shizhong, settling the surrendered troops, and forming them into a separate army.
translations.idiomatic: At this point he advanced to attack Tianchang; Zhaoshou responded from within and the city was taken. He then offered up Chuzhou; a memorial was submitted appointing him regimental commander, changing his name to Shizhong, settling the surrendered troops, and forming them into a separate army.

sentences.zh: 九年，克六安，捻首張元龍以鳳陽降，复臨淮關。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he captured Lu'an; the Nian chieftain Zhang Yuanlong surrendered Fengyang, and Linhuai Pass was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1859) he captured Lu'an; the Nian chieftain Zhang Yuanlong surrendered Fengyang, and Linhuai Pass was recovered.

sentences.zh: 進克霍山、盱眙，破賊清水鎮，斬其酋吳加孝，遂克懷遠，而廬州、定遠久未下，賊仍蔓延。

translations.literal: He advanced to capture Huoshan and Xuyi, defeated the bandits at Qingshui Town and beheaded their chieftain Wu Jiaxiao, then captured Huaiyuan; but Luzhou and Dingyuan long remained untaken and the bandits still spread.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to capture Huoshan and Xuyi, defeated the rebels at Qingshui Town and beheaded their chieftain Wu Jiaxiao, then captured Huaiyuan; but Luzhou and Dingyuan long remained untaken and the rebels still spread.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，奪情留軍。

translations.literal: When his mother died he was in mourning, but his leave was suspended and he remained with the army.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he was in mourning, but his leave was suspended and he remained with the army.

sentences.zh: 十年，罷欽差大臣，命赴河南剿匪。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was removed as imperial commissioner and ordered to go to Henan to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1860) he was removed as imperial commissioner and ordered to go to Henan to suppress bandits.

sentences.zh: 御史林之望論劾，降授鑲藍旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: The censor Lin Zhiwang memorialized in impeachment; he was demoted and appointed vice commander of the Han Chinese Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: The censor Lin Zhiwang memorialized in impeachment; he was demoted and appointed vice commander of the Han Chinese Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 复坐剿匪不力，降授光祿寺卿，召回京。

translations.literal: Again, on the charge of suppressing bandits without vigor, he was demoted to minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Again, on the charge of suppressing bandits without vigor, he was demoted to minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甫至，會英法聯軍內犯，命率八旗禁軍駐定福莊，偕僧格林沁、瑞麟進戰通州八里橋，敗績，勝保受傷，退保京師。

translations.literal: Hardly had he arrived when the Anglo-French allied armies invaded inland; he was ordered to lead the Eight Banner palace guard to encamp at Dingfuzhuang and, together with Sengge Rinchen and Ruilin, advance to fight at Baliqiao in Tongzhou. They were defeated; Sheng Bao was wounded and withdrew to defend the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Hardly had he arrived when the Anglo-French allied armies invaded inland; he was ordered to lead the Eight Banner palace guard to encamp at Dingfuzhuang and, together with Sengge Rinchen and Ruilin, advance to fight at Baliqiao in Tongzhou. They were defeated; Sheng Bao was wounded and withdrew to defend the capital.

sentences.zh: 停戰議和，勝保收集各路潰軍及勤王師續至者共萬餘人。

translations.literal: When fighting ceased and peace was negotiated, Sheng Bao gathered routed troops from various routes and relief armies that continued to arrive, totaling more than ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: When fighting ceased and peace was negotiated, Sheng Bao gathered routed troops from various routes and relief armies that continued to arrive, totaling more than ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 疏陳京兵亟應訓練，擬議章程以進。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial stating that the capital troops urgently needed training and drafted regulations for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial stating that the capital troops urgently needed training and drafted regulations for presentation.

sentences.zh: 命兼管圓明園八旗、內務府包衣三旗，親督操練，是為改練京兵之始。

translations.literal: He was ordered to take charge concurrently of the Eight Banners of the Old Summer Palace and the three domestic-service banners of the Imperial Household Department, personally supervising drill—this was the beginning of reorganizing and training the capital troops.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to take charge concurrently of the Eight Banners of the Old Summer Palace and the three domestic-service banners of the Imperial Household Department, personally supervising drill—this was the beginning of reorganizing and training the capital troops.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢兵部侍郎，捻匪擾山東，詔分所部五千人畀僧格林沁往剿。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was promoted to vice minister of the Board of War; when Nian bandits harassed Shandong, an edict divided five thousand of his troops and gave them to Sengge Rinchen to go suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1861) he was promoted to vice minister of the Board of War; when Nian bandits harassed Shandong, an edict divided five thousand of his troops and gave them to Sengge Rinchen to go suppress them.

sentences.zh: 尋命勝保赴直、東交界治防，連克丘縣、館陶、冠縣、莘縣，破賊老巢。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Sheng Bao was ordered to go to the border between Zhili and Shandong to manage defense; he in succession captured Qiu County, Guantao, Guan County, and Shen County and destroyed the bandits' old stronghold.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Sheng Bao was ordered to go to the border between Zhili and Shandong to manage defense; he in succession captured Qiu County, Guantao, Guan County, and Shen County and destroyed the bandits' old stronghold.

sentences.zh: 招降捻首宋景詩，率眾隨軍。

translations.literal: He recruited the surrender of the Nian chieftain Song Jingshi, who led his followers with the army.
translations.idiomatic: He recruited the surrender of the Nian chieftain Song Jingshi, who led his followers with the army.

sentences.zh: 复朝城、觀城，命督辦河南、安徽剿匪事宜。

translations.literal: He recovered Chaocheng and Guancheng and was ordered to supervise the suppression of bandits in Henan and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: He recovered Chaocheng and Guancheng and was ordered to supervise the suppression of bandits in Henan and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 河北肅清，予優敘。

translations.literal: When Hebei was pacified he was given special commendation.
translations.idiomatic: When Hebei was pacified he was given special commendation.

sentences.zh: 是年七月，文宗崩於行在，穆宗嗣位，肅順、載垣、端華等輔政專擅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of that year Emperor Wenzong died at the traveling palace; Emperor Muzong succeeded to the throne, and Sušun, Zaiyuan, Duanhua, and others monopolized power as regents.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of that year Emperor Wenzong died at the traveling palace; Emperor Muzong succeeded to the throne, and Sušun, Zaiyuan, Duanhua, and others monopolized power as regents.

sentences.zh: 勝保昌言將入清君側，肅順等頗忌憚之。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao openly declared that he would enter the capital to purge the emperor's side, and Sušun and the others were much wary of him.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao openly declared that he would enter the capital to purge the emperor's side, and Sušun and the others were much wary of him.

sentences.zh: 洎回鑾，上疏曰：「政柄操之自上，非臣下所得專。

translations.literal: When the court returned to the capital he submitted a memorial stating: 'Political power is wielded from above; it is not for subordinates to monopolize.
translations.idiomatic: When the court returned to the capital he submitted a memorial stating: 'Political power is wielded from above; it is not for subordinates to monopolize.

sentences.zh: 皇上沖齡嗣位，輔政得人，方足以資治理。

translations.literal: The emperor succeeded at a tender age; only if the regents are well chosen can they truly assist in governance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor succeeded at a tender age; only if the regents are well chosen can they truly assist in governance.

sentences.zh: 怡親王載垣、鄭親王端華等非不宣力有年，赫赫師尹，民具爾瞻；

translations.literal: Prince Yi Zaiyuan and Prince Zheng Duanhua and others have not failed to exert themselves for years; they are eminent ministers on whom the people look;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yi Zaiyuan and Prince Zheng Duanhua and others have not failed to exert themselves for years; they are eminent ministers on whom the people look;

sentences.zh: 今竟攬君國大權，以臣僕而代綸音，挾至尊而令天下，實無以副寄託之望，而饜四海之心。

translations.literal: yet now they have seized the great power of state, substituting imperial edicts as mere servants, commanding the realm by holding the sovereign in their grasp—this truly cannot fulfill the hopes placed in them or satisfy the hearts of all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: yet now they have seized the great power of state, substituting imperial edicts as mere servants, commanding the realm by holding the sovereign in their grasp—this truly cannot fulfill the hopes placed in them or satisfy the hearts of all under heaven.

sentences.zh: 該王等以承寫硃諭為辭，居之不疑。

translations.literal: These princes take the copying of vermilion edicts as their justification and occupy their posts without doubt.
translations.idiomatic: These princes take the copying of vermilion edicts as their justification and occupy their posts without doubt.

sentences.zh: 不知皇上纘承大統，天與人歸，原不以硃諭之有無為重。

translations.literal: They do not know that the emperor succeeded to the great succession with the mandate of heaven and the assent of men; originally the presence or absence of vermilion edicts was not what mattered.
translations.idiomatic: They do not know that the emperor succeeded to the great succession with the mandate of heaven and the assent of men; originally the presence or absence of vermilion edicts was not what mattered.

sentences.zh: 至贊襄政務，當以親親尊賢為斷，不當專以承寫為憑。

translations.literal: As for assisting in government affairs, one should decide by honoring kin and respecting the worthy, not rely solely on the copying of edicts.
translations.idiomatic: As for assisting in government affairs, one should decide by honoring kin and respecting the worthy, not rely solely on the copying of edicts.

sentences.zh: 先皇帝彌留之際，近支親王多不在側。

translations.literal: At the late emperor's final illness, many close imperial princes were not at his side.
translations.idiomatic: At the late emperor's final illness, many close imperial princes were not at his side.

sentences.zh: 仰窺顧命苦衷，所以未留親筆硃諭者，未必非以輔政之難得其人，待皇上自擇而任之，以成未竟之志也。

translations.literal: Looking up to discern the anguish of the deathbed command, the reason no personally written vermilion edict was left may well have been that suitable regents were hard to find, and he wished to wait for the emperor to choose and appoint them himself, to fulfill his uncompleted will.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up to discern the anguish of the deathbed command, the reason no personally written vermilion edict was left may well have been that suitable regents were hard to find, and he wished to wait for the emperor to choose and appoint them himself, to fulfill his uncompleted will.

sentences.zh: 嗣聖既未親政，皇太后又不臨朝，是政柄盡付之該王等數人。

translations.literal: The succeeding sovereign had not yet personally ruled, and the empress dowager did not hold court; thus political power was entirely entrusted to these few princes.
translations.idiomatic: The succeeding sovereign had not yet personally ruled, and the empress dowager did not hold court; thus political power was entirely entrusted to these few princes.

sentences.zh: 其託諸掣籤簡放，鈐用符信圖章，以此取信於人，無如人皆不信，民碞可畏，天下難欺。

translations.literal: They rely on drawing lots for appointments and applying seals and official stamps to win people's trust, but people do not believe them; popular opinion is to be feared, and all under heaven cannot be deceived.
translations.idiomatic: They rely on drawing lots for appointments and applying seals and official stamps to win people's trust, but people do not believe them; popular opinion is to be feared, and all under heaven cannot be deceived.

sentences.zh: 近如御史董元醇條陳，極有關係，應準應駁，惟當斷自聖裁，廣集廷議，以定行止。

translations.literal: Recently, as with the censor Dong Yuanchun's memorial, the matter was of great importance; whether to approve or reject it should be decided solely by the sacred judgment, with broad consultation in court deliberation to determine the course of action.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, as with the censor Dong Yuanchun's memorial, the matter was of great importance; whether to approve or reject it should be decided solely by the sacred judgment, with broad consultation in court deliberation to determine the course of action.

sentences.zh: 乃徑行擬旨駁斥，已開矯竊之端，大失臣民之望。

translations.literal: Yet they directly drafted an edict to reject it, already opening the way to usurpation, and greatly disappointing officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they directly drafted an edict to reject it, already opening the way to usurpation, and greatly disappointing officials and people.

sentences.zh: 道路之人皆曰：'此非吾君之言也，非母后聖母之意也。

translations.literal: People on the road all say: 'These are not our sovereign's words, nor the empress dowager's intent.
translations.idiomatic: People on the road all say: 'These are not our sovereign's words, nor the empress dowager's intent.

sentences.zh: '一切發號施令，真偽難分。

translations.literal: In all issuing of commands and orders, true and false are hard to distinguish.
translations.idiomatic: In every order issued, it is hard to tell what is genuine and what is not.

sentences.zh: 眾情洶洶，咸懷不服。

translations.literal: Public sentiment was turbulent; all harbored discontent.
translations.idiomatic: Public sentiment ran high, and everyone felt aggrieved.

sentences.zh: 夫天下者，宣宗成皇帝之天下，傳之文宗顯皇帝以付之我皇上者也。

translations.literal: The realm belongs to Emperor Xuanzong Cheng; it was transmitted to Emperor Wenzong Xian and entrusted to our present sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: The realm belongs to Emperor Xuanzong; it passed to Emperor Wenzong and was entrusted to our present sovereign.

sentences.zh: 昔我文皇后雖無垂簾之明文，而有聽政之實用。

translations.literal: Formerly our Empress Wen, though without explicit words about ruling from behind the curtain, had the practical effect of hearing and deciding government.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Empress Wen, though she never formally ruled from behind a curtain, in practice did hear and decide affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 為今之計，非皇太后親理萬幾，召對群臣，無以通下情而正國體；

translations.literal: For the present plan, unless the empress dowager personally handles the myriad affairs and summons officials for audience, there is no way to convey the feelings below and rectify the form of the state;
translations.idiomatic: For the present, unless the empress dowager personally handles affairs of state and receives officials in audience, there is no way to convey the people's feelings below and restore proper governance;

sentences.zh: 非特簡近支親王佐理庶政，盡心匡弼，無以振紀綱而順人心。

translations.literal: unless close imperial princes are specially selected to assist in ordinary government and devote themselves to support, there is no way to revive discipline and accord with popular sentiment.
translations.idiomatic: unless close imperial princes are specially chosen to assist in government and devote themselves to counsel, there is no way to restore discipline and win popular assent.

sentences.zh: 惟有籥懇皇上俯察芻蕘，即奉皇太后權宜聽政，而於近支親王擇賢而任，仍秉命而行，以成郅治。」

translations.literal: There is only to earnestly beg the emperor to look down and examine this humble counsel: immediately have the empress dowager provisionally hear government, and among close imperial princes choose the worthy and appoint them, still acting by command, to achieve perfect order.'
translations.idiomatic: I can only earnestly beg the emperor to consider this humble counsel: let the empress dowager provisionally hear government, choose worthy close imperial princes to assist, and have them still act by imperial command, so that perfect order may be achieved.'

sentences.zh: 奏上，會大學士周祖培等亦以為言，下廷議，從之。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, Grand Secretary Zhou Zupei and others also spoke to the same effect; it was sent down for court deliberation and adopted.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, Grand Secretary Zhou Zupei and others spoke to the same effect; the court deliberated and adopted the proposal.

sentences.zh: 肅順等並伏法。

translations.literal: Sušun and the others were all executed according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Sušun and the others were all executed.

sentences.zh: 尋授鑲黃旗滿洲都統兼正藍旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed lieutenant general of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and concurrently commander of the guard of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed lieutenant general of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner and concurrently commander of the guard of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 時捻匪肆擾皖、豫間，以張洛行為最強。

translations.literal: At the time Nian bandits rampaged between Anhui and Henan, with Zhang Luoxing as the strongest.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Nian bandits rampaged between Anhui and Henan, and Zhang Luoxing was the strongest among them.

sentences.zh: 苗沛霖自踞壽州，逼走巡撫翁同書後，佯稱就撫，陰與粵匪陳玉成勾結。

translations.literal: Miao Peilin had seized Shouzhou on his own; after driving away Governor Weng Tongshu he feigned submission while secretly colluding with the Cantonese bandit Chen Yucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Peilin had seized Shouzhou on his own; after driving away Governor Weng Tongshu he feigned submission while secretly colluding with the Taiping general Chen Yucheng.

sentences.zh: 署巡撫賈臻被圍於潁州，久不解。

translations.literal: Acting Governor Jia Zhen was besieged at Yingzhou and for a long time the siege was not lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Governor Jia Zhen was besieged at Yingzhou, and the siege could not be lifted for a long time.

sentences.zh: 楚軍已克安慶，陳玉成退踞廬州。

translations.literal: The Chu army had already captured Anqing, and Chen Yucheng withdrew to hold Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunan army had already captured Anqing, and Chen Yucheng withdrew to hold Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 朝廷本意安徽軍事屬之李續宜，用為巡撫。

translations.literal: The court's original intent was that Anhui military affairs belong to Li Xuyi, who was appointed governor.
translations.idiomatic: The court's original intent was to put Anhui military affairs under Li Xuyi, who was appointed governor.

sentences.zh: 沛霖舊隸勝保部下，心憚楚軍，揚言勝保來始薙發。

translations.literal: Peilin had formerly served under Sheng Bao; fearing the Chu army in his heart, he declared that he would shave his head and submit only when Sheng Bao came.
translations.idiomatic: Peilin had formerly served under Sheng Bao; fearing the Hunan army, he declared that he would shave his head and submit only when Sheng Bao came.

sentences.zh: 賈臻以聞，詔促勝保援潁州。

translations.literal: Jia Zhen reported this, and an edict urged Sheng Bao to relieve Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhen reported this, and an edict ordered Sheng Bao to hurry to relieve Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，遣軍先進，為賊所挫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he sent troops ahead, and they were defeated by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi (1862) he sent troops ahead, and they were defeated by the rebels.

sentences.zh: 三月，勝保至，擊破賊壘，圍乃解，加兵部尚書銜。

translations.literal: In the third month Sheng Bao arrived, attacked and broke the bandit stockades, and the siege was lifted; he was given the rank of minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Sheng Bao arrived, stormed the rebel stockades, and lifted the siege; he was given the rank of minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿等克廬州，陳玉成遁走，沛霖誘擒之，獻於勝保軍。

translations.literal: Duolong'a and others captured Luzhou; Chen Yucheng fled, and Peilin lured and captured him, presenting him to Sheng Bao's army.
translations.idiomatic: Duolong'a and others captured Luzhou; Chen Yucheng fled, and Peilin lured and captured him, then presented him to Sheng Bao's army.

sentences.zh: 詔於軍前誅玉成，赦沛霖罪，許立功後復官。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yucheng executed before the army; Peilin's crimes were pardoned and he was permitted to recover office after meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yucheng executed before the army; Peilin's crimes were pardoned and he was permitted to recover office after meritorious service.

sentences.zh: 沛霖擁眾號十萬，所屬二百餘圩。

translations.literal: Peilin commanded a force said to number one hundred thousand, with more than two hundred stockaded villages under him.
translations.idiomatic: Peilin commanded a force said to number one hundred thousand, with more than two hundred stockaded villages under his control.

sentences.zh: 與張洛行勢敵相仇，自請剿之，心實叵測。

translations.literal: He was a match in strength for Zhang Luoxing and their enmity was mutual; he volunteered to suppress him, but his intent was in truth hard to fathom.
translations.idiomatic: He was a match in strength for Zhang Luoxing and they were bitter enemies; he volunteered to suppress him, but his true intent was hard to fathom.

sentences.zh: 詔詢曾國籓、官文、李續宜、袁甲三等，皆主剿。

translations.literal: An edict inquired of Zeng Guofan, Guanwen, Li Xuyi, Yuan Jiasan, and others; all advocated suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The throne asked Zeng Guofan, Guanwen, Li Xuyi, Yuan Jiasan, and others; all advocated suppression.

sentences.zh: 獨勝保一意主撫，上疏言事權不一，身為客軍，地方掣肘，請以安徽、河南兩巡撫幫辦軍務，允之。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao alone insisted on pacification; he submitted a memorial saying authority was not unified, that as a guest army he was checked by local officials, and requested that the governors of Anhui and Henan assist in military affairs; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao alone insisted on pacification; he submitted a memorial saying authority was not unified, that as a guest army he was hamstrung by local officials, and requested that the governors of Anhui and Henan assist in military affairs; this was granted.

sentences.zh: 迭詔訓飭，褒其才略，戒其驕愎。

translations.literal: Repeated edicts admonished and instructed him, praising his talent and strategy while warning against his arrogance and obstinacy.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated edicts admonished him, praising his talent and strategy while warning against his arrogance and obstinacy.

sentences.zh: 卒不悛，力言沛霖無他，而為李續宜所疑，恐激變。

translations.literal: In the end he did not reform; he strongly maintained that Peilin had no ulterior motive, but Li Xuyi was suspicious and feared provoking a revolt.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he did not reform; he strongly maintained that Peilin had no ulterior motive, but Li Xuyi was suspicious and feared provoking a revolt.

sentences.zh: 續宜奉旨進駐潁州，亦迄不至。

translations.literal: Xuyi received an order to advance and encamp at Yingzhou, but in the end never came.
translations.idiomatic: Xuyi received an order to advance and encamp at Yingzhou, but in the end never came.

sentences.zh: 會陝西回亂熾，多隆阿援軍阻隔不能遽達。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the Muslim rebellion in Shaanxi flared; Duolong'a's relief army was blocked and could not arrive quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the Muslim rebellion in Shaanxi flared; Duolong'a's relief army was blocked and could not arrive quickly.

sentences.zh: 遂授勝保欽差大臣，督辦陝西軍務。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao was then appointed imperial commissioner to supervise Shaanxi military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao was then appointed imperial commissioner to supervise Shaanxi military affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月，轉戰至西安，解其圍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he fought in turn to Xi'an and lifted its siege.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he fought his way to Xi'an and lifted its siege.

sentences.zh: 降捻宋景詩中途率眾叛走。

translations.literal: The surrendered Nian Song Jingshi midway led his followers in rebellion and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered Nian leader Song Jingshi midway led his followers in rebellion and fled.

sentences.zh: 東路同州、朝邑猶為回踞，詔責勝保專剿東路，命多隆阿進軍分任西路。

translations.literal: On the eastern route Tongzhou and Chaoyi were still held by Muslims; an edict charged Sheng Bao to suppress the eastern route exclusively and ordered Duolong'a to advance and share responsibility for the western route.
translations.idiomatic: On the eastern route Tongzhou and Chaoyi were still held by Muslim rebels; an edict charged Sheng Bao to suppress the eastern route exclusively and ordered Duolong'a to advance and take responsibility for the western route.

sentences.zh: 勝保力不能制賊，而忌多隆阿，擅調苗沛霖率兵赴陝，嚴詔斥阻，不聽。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao lacked the strength to control the bandits yet was jealous of Duolong'a; on his own authority he ordered Miao Peilin to lead troops to Shaanxi. A stern edict rebuked and blocked this, but he would not obey.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao lacked the strength to control the rebels yet was jealous of Duolong'a; on his own authority he ordered Miao Peilin to lead troops to Shaanxi. A stern edict rebuked and blocked this, but he would not obey.

sentences.zh: 命僧格林沁大軍監製，乃止。

translations.literal: Sengge Rinchen's grand army was ordered to supervise, and only then did he stop.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen's grand army was ordered to supervise, and only then did he stop.

sentences.zh: 於是中外交章劾勝保驕縱貪婬，冒餉納賄，擁兵縱寇，欺罔貽誤，下僧格林沁及山西巡撫英桂、西安副都統德興阿察實奏上，密詔多隆阿率師至陝，傳旨宣布勝保罪狀，褫職逮京，交刑部治罪，籍其家。

translations.literal: Thereupon officials at court and in the provinces alike memorialized impeaching Sheng Bao for arrogance, indulgence, greed, and lechery, false claims on pay and acceptance of bribes, holding troops while letting bandits go free, and deception causing failure. The matter was sent down to Sengge Rinchen, Shanxi Governor Yinggui, and Xi'an Vice Commander De Xing'a to investigate and report; a secret edict ordered Duolong'a to lead his army to Shaanxi, proclaim Sheng Bao's crimes, strip him of office, arrest him and send him to the capital, hand him over to the Board of Punishments for trial, and confiscate his property.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon officials at court and in the provinces alike memorialized impeaching Sheng Bao for arrogance, indulgence, greed, and lechery, false claims on pay and acceptance of bribes, holding troops while letting rebels go free, and deception that caused military failure. The matter was sent down to Sengge Rinchen, Shanxi Governor Yinggui, and Xi'an Vice Commander De Xing'a to investigate and report; a secret edict ordered Duolong'a to lead his army to Shaanxi, proclaim Sheng Bao's crimes, strip him of office, arrest him and send him to the capital, hand him over to the Board of Punishments for trial, and confiscate his property.

sentences.zh: 二年，王大臣會鞫，勝保僅自承攜妾隨營，呈訴參劾諸人誣告之罪。

translations.literal: In the second year princes and ministers jointly tried the case; Sheng Bao admitted only that he had brought a concubine with the camp and submitted a plea accusing those who impeached him of false accusation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year princes and ministers jointly tried the case; Sheng Bao admitted only that he had brought a concubine with the camp and submitted a plea accusing his accusers of false testimony.

sentences.zh: 詔斥其貪污欺罔，天下共知，苗沛霖已戕官踞城，宋景詩反覆背叛，皆其養筴貽患，不得謂無挾制朝廷之意；

translations.literal: An edict rebuked him: his corruption and deception were known to all; Miao Peilin had already killed officials and seized cities, and Song Jingshi had repeatedly betrayed—all were evils he had nurtured and bequeathed; it could not be said that he had no intent to coerce the court;
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked him: his corruption and deception were known to all; Miao Peilin had already killed officials and seized cities, and Song Jingshi had repeatedly betrayed—all were evils he had nurtured and bequeathed; it could not be said that he had no intent to coerce the court;

sentences.zh: 念其戰功足錄，從寬賜自盡，並逮其從官論罪有差。

translations.literal: Considering that his battle merits were sufficient to be recorded, he was granted the leniency of being allowed to commit suicide, and his attendant officials were arrested and punished according to their respective degrees of guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Considering that his battle merits were sufficient to be recorded, he was granted the leniency of being allowed to commit suicide, and his attendant officials were arrested and punished according to their respective degrees of guilt.

sentences.zh: 當其被逮也，降捻李世忠已擢至提督，請黜己官為之贖罪，不許。

translations.literal: When he was arrested, the surrendered Nian Li Shizhong had already been promoted to provincial commander; he requested that his own office be removed to redeem Sheng Bao's guilt, but this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: When he was arrested, the surrendered Nian leader Li Shizhong had already been promoted to provincial commander; he requested that his own office be removed to redeem Sheng Bao's guilt, but this was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 御史吳台壽疏言勝保有克敵禦侮之功，無失地喪師之罪，請從末減。

translations.literal: The censor Wu Taishou submitted a memorial saying Sheng Bao had the merit of defeating enemies and repelling insult, and had no crime of losing territory or armies; he requested the lightest possible reduction of sentence.
translations.idiomatic: The censor Wu Taishou submitted a memorial saying Sheng Bao had the merit of defeating enemies and repelling insult, and had no crime of losing territory or armies; he requested the lightest possible reduction of sentence.

sentences.zh: 台壽兄台朗在勝保軍中，詔斥黨附，褫台壽職。

translations.literal: Taishou's elder brother Tailang was in Sheng Bao's army; an edict rebuked this as factional attachment and stripped Taishou of office.
translations.idiomatic: Taishou's elder brother Tailang was in Sheng Bao's army; an edict rebuked this as factional attachment and stripped Taishou of office.

sentences.zh: 托明阿，棟鄂氏，滿洲正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Tuo Ming'a, of the Donggo clan, was a man of the Plain Red Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Ming'a, of the Donggo clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 由侍衛擢護軍參領，出為山東兗州營游擊。

translations.literal: From bodyguard he was promoted to company commander of the guard and went out to serve as battalion commander of the Yanzhou garrison in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: From bodyguard he was promoted to company commander of the guard and went out to serve as battalion commander of the Yanzhou garrison in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 從巡撫武隆阿徵回疆，以功賜花翎。

translations.literal: He followed Governor Wulong'a in campaigning in the Western Regions and, for merit, was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Governor Wulong'a in campaigning in the Western Regions and, for merit, was granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 累擢曹州鎮總兵，調四川松潘、重慶二鎮。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to regional commander of Caozhou and transferred to the two commands of Songpan and Chongqing in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to regional commander of Caozhou and transferred to the two commands of Songpan and Chongqing in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 道光二十四年，擢四川提督，以病去職。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Daoguang he was promoted to provincial commander of Sichuan and left office due to illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Daoguang (1844) he was promoted to provincial commander of Sichuan and left office due to illness.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，起授烏魯木齊提督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was recalled and appointed provincial commander of Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year (1847) he was recalled and appointed provincial commander of Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 調陝西，擢綏遠城將軍，整飭戎政，勤於訓練。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Shaanxi, promoted to general of Garrisoned Troops at Suiyuan, put military administration in order, and was diligent in training.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Shaanxi, promoted to general of Garrisoned Troops at Suiyuan, put military administration in order, and was diligent in training.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，粵匪林鳳祥等陷揚州，逼淮、徐，命率所部赴江南、山東交界防堵，進屯清江浦。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng the Cantonese bandits Lin Fengxiang and others took Yangzhou and threatened Huai and Xu; he was ordered to lead his troops to the border between Jiangnan and Shandong to block them and advanced to encamp at Qingjiangpu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng (1853) the Taiping generals Lin Fengxiang and others took Yangzhou and threatened Huai and Xu; he was ordered to lead his troops to the border between Jiangnan and Shandong to block them and advanced to encamp at Qingjiangpu.

sentences.zh: 賊竄滁州，托明阿赴援，與週天爵會剿。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to Chuzhou; Tuo Ming'a went to relieve it and joined Zhou Tianjue in joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Chuzhou; Tuo Ming'a went to relieve it and joined Zhou Tianjue in joint suppression.

sentences.zh: 遂追賊至河南，迭戰於睢州、杞縣、陳留、中牟，進克汜水，殲賊千餘，被珍賚，命襄辦軍務。

translations.literal: He then pursued the bandits to Henan and fought repeatedly at Suizhou, Qixian, Chenliu, and Zhongmu; he advanced and captured Sishui, destroyed more than a thousand bandits, received imperial rewards, and was ordered to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He then pursued the rebels to Henan and fought repeatedly at Suizhou, Qixian, Chenliu, and Zhongmu; he advanced and captured Sishui, destroyed more than a thousand rebels, received imperial rewards, and was ordered to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 賊竄河北，圍懷慶，乃渡河會諸軍分路進攻，迭有斬獲。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to Hebei and besieged Huaqing; he crossed the river, joined the various armies in advancing by separate routes, and repeatedly achieved kills and captures.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Hebei and besieged Huaqing; he crossed the river, joined the various armies in advancing by separate routes, and repeatedly achieved kills and captures.

sentences.zh: 賊築土城樹木柵以拒，合攻破之，擒斬數千。

translations.literal: The bandits built an earthen wall and planted wooden palisades to resist; the combined forces broke through, capturing and beheading several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels built an earthen wall and planted wooden palisades to resist; the combined forces broke through, capturing and beheading several thousand.

sentences.zh: 賊始遁，懷慶圍解。

translations.literal: The bandits then fled and the siege of Huaqing was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then fled and the siege of Huaqing was lifted.

sentences.zh: 論功，賜黃馬褂，予西林巴圖魯名號。

translations.literal: When merits were assessed he was granted the yellow riding jacket and given the title of Xilin Batūru.
translations.idiomatic: When merits were assessed he was granted the yellow riding jacket and given the title of Xilin Batūru.

sentences.zh: 追賊山西，詔以勝保督師，命托明阿襄辦。

translations.literal: In pursuing the bandits into Shanxi, an edict put Sheng Bao in command and ordered Tuo Ming'a to assist.
translations.idiomatic: In pursuing the rebels into Shanxi, an edict put Sheng Bao in command and ordered Tuo Ming'a to assist.

sentences.zh: 賊竄入直隸境，坐降五級留任，尋以傷劇解職回旗。

translations.literal: When the bandits fled into Zhili territory he was demoted five ranks but retained in office; soon afterward, because his wounds were severe, he was relieved of office and returned to his banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels fled into Zhili territory he was demoted five ranks but retained in office; soon afterward, because his wounds were severe, he was relieved of office and returned to his banner.

sentences.zh: 四年春，病痊，命赴直隸，仍幫辦僧格林沁、勝保軍務。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, when his illness was cured, he was ordered to go to Zhili and again assist in the military affairs of Sengge Rinchen and Sheng Bao.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year (1854), when his illness was cured, he was ordered to go to Zhili and again assist in the military affairs of Sengge Rinchen and Sheng Bao.

sentences.zh: 賊方踞阜城，堅守不出，諸軍圍之。

translations.literal: The bandits were then holding Fucheng, defending stubbornly without coming out, and the various armies besieged them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were then holding Fucheng, defending stubbornly without coming out, and the various armies besieged them.

sentences.zh: 托明阿屯東北，賊來撲，輒擊退，突由東南隅竄出，踞連鎮，夾運河。

translations.literal: Tuo Ming'a encamped on the northeast; when the bandits came to attack he always drove them back, but they suddenly broke out from the southeast corner, seized Lianzhen, and straddled the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Ming'a encamped on the northeast; when the rebels came to attack he always drove them back, but they suddenly broke out from the southeast corner, seized Lianzhen, and straddled the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 托明阿與都統西凌阿軍東西兩岸，圍復合。

translations.literal: Tuo Ming'a and Lieutenant General Xiling'a encamped on the eastern and western banks, and the encirclement was re-formed.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Ming'a and Lieutenant General Xiling'a encamped on the eastern and western banks, and the encirclement was re-formed.

sentences.zh: 會琦善督師揚州，卒於軍，命托明阿為欽差大臣，馳往代之，授江寧將軍。

translations.literal: When Qishan was commanding at Yangzhou he died in camp; Tuo Ming'a was appointed imperial commissioner, ordered to hurry there and replace him, and given the post of general of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: When Qishan was commanding at Yangzhou he died in camp; Tuo Ming'a was appointed imperial commissioner, ordered to hurry there and replace him, and given the post of general of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 自賊踞江寧，鎮江、揚州皆陷，南北梗阻，大軍分兩路，向榮軍江南，琦善軍江北。

translations.literal: Since the bandits held Jiangning, Zhenjiang and Yangzhou had both fallen, and north-south communications were blocked; the grand army was divided into two routes—Xiang Rong's army in Jiangnan and Qishan's army north of the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: Since the rebels held Jiangning, Zhenjiang and Yangzhou had both fallen, and north-south communications were blocked; the grand army was divided into two routes—Xiang Rong's army in Jiangnan and Qishan's army north of the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 江北軍攻揚州不能克，賊棄城去，聚於瓜洲，與南岸鎮江相犄角。

translations.literal: The army north of the Yangzi attacked Yangzhou but could not take it; the bandits abandoned the city and gathered at Guazhou, forming a pincer with Zhenjiang on the south bank.
translations.idiomatic: The army north of the Yangzi attacked Yangzhou but could not take it; the rebels abandoned the city and gathered at Guazhou, forming a pincer with Zhenjiang on the south bank.

sentences.zh: 江寧賊時乘鉅簰順流而下，陸師不能扼，水師力薄，亦不能制賊。

translations.literal: The Jiangning bandits at times rode great rafts downstream; the land force could not block them, and the naval force was too weak to control the bandits either.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangning rebels at times rode great rafts downstream; the land force could not block them, and the naval force was too weak to control the rebels either.

sentences.zh: 上游浦口最當衝要，賊於沙洲結營，時圖進竄。

translations.literal: Upstream, Pukou was the most critical point; the bandits established camps on the sandbars and at times plotted to advance and flee.
translations.idiomatic: Upstream, Pukou was the most critical point; the rebels established camps on the sandbars and at times plotted to advance further.

sentences.zh: 恃總兵武慶一軍及道員溫紹原六合練勇為屏蔽，亦不能進取。

translations.literal: Relying on Regional Commander Wu Qing's army and Circuit Intendant Wen Shaoyuan's trained militia of Liuhe as a shield, they still could not advance and seize ground.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on Regional Commander Wu Qing's army and Circuit Intendant Wen Shaoyuan's trained militia of Liuhe as a shield, they still could not advance and seize ground.

sentences.zh: 托明阿至軍，令副將鞠殿華毀運河鐵钅巢，提督陳金綬循東岸進攻，小有斬獲。

translations.literal: When Tuo Ming'a arrived at the army he ordered Brigade Commander Ju Dianhua to destroy the iron chains on the Grand Canal; Provincial Commander Chen Jinshou advanced along the eastern bank and achieved some kills and captures.
translations.idiomatic: When Tuo Ming'a arrived at the army he ordered Brigade Commander Ju Dianhua to destroy the iron chains on the Grand Canal; Provincial Commander Chen Jinshou advanced along the eastern bank and achieved some kills and captures.

sentences.zh: 又截擊賊簰，斃偽丞相黃起茅。

translations.literal: He again intercepted and attacked the bandits' rafts and killed the false chancellor Huang Qimao.
translations.idiomatic: He again intercepted and attacked the rebels' rafts and killed the false chancellor Huang Qimao.

sentences.zh: 自督舟師渡江，略北固山、金山而還。

translations.literal: He personally led the fleet across the river, skirmished at Beigu Mountain and Jinshan, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: He personally led the fleet across the river, skirmished at Beigu Mountain and Jinshan, and returned.

sentences.zh: 五年，瓜洲、鎮江賊合犯儀徵，令副都統德興阿、總兵李志和擊退。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the bandits of Guazhou and Zhenjiang jointly attacked Yizheng; he ordered Vice Commander De Xing'a and Regional Commander Li Zhihe to drive them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1855) the rebels of Guazhou and Zhenjiang jointly attacked Yizheng; he ordered Vice Commander De Xing'a and Regional Commander Li Zhihe to drive them back.

sentences.zh: 又進軍三汊河，誘賊敗之。

translations.literal: He again advanced to Sanhe River, lured the bandits, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: He again advanced to Sanhe River, lured the rebels, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 托明阿見僧格林沁於連鎮、馮官屯皆以圍牆制賊，議仿其法，於瓜洲築長圍以困之。

translations.literal: Tuo Ming'a saw that at Lianzhen and Fengguantun Sengge Rinchen had used encircling walls to control the bandits; he proposed copying this method and building a long encirclement at Guazhou to wear them down.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Ming'a saw that at Lianzhen and Fengguantun Sengge Rinchen had used encircling walls to control the rebels; he proposed copying this method and building a long encirclement at Guazhou to wear them down.

sentences.zh: 然瓜洲濱大江，江路不斷，且地勢袤長不易守，實無足恃。

translations.literal: Yet Guazhou bordered the great river; the river route was never cut off, and the terrain was long and hard to defend—it truly offered little to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Guazhou bordered the great river; the river route was never cut off, and the terrain was long and hard to defend—it truly offered little to rely on.

sentences.zh: 圍成，屢偕陳金綬進攻，無大勝利。

translations.literal: When the encirclement was complete he repeatedly joined Chen Jinshou in advancing to attack, but there were no great victories.
translations.idiomatic: When the encirclement was complete he repeatedly joined Chen Jinshou in advancing to attack, but there were no great victories.

sentences.zh: 江寧賊踞江浦石磯橋，武慶​​、西昌阿等馳擊，克之。

translations.literal: The Jiangning bandits held Shiji Bridge at Jiangpu; Wu Qing, Xichang'a, and others hurried to attack and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangning rebels held Shiji Bridge at Jiangpu; Wu Qing, Xichang'a, and others hurried to attack and captured it.

sentences.zh: 巡撫吉爾杭阿督師攻鎮江甚急，於是議南北同時進剿。

translations.literal: Governor Ji'erhang'a was pressing the attack on Zhenjiang very hard; thereupon it was proposed that north and south advance to suppress the bandits simultaneously.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Ji'erhang'a was pressing the attack on Zhenjiang very hard; thereupon it was proposed that north and south advance to suppress the rebels simultaneously.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，江寧賊大舉援鎮江，未得逞。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year the Jiangning bandits came in force to relieve Zhenjiang but did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year (1856) the Jiangning rebels came in force to relieve Zhenjiang but did not succeed.

sentences.zh: 渡江與瓜洲賊合，突越土圍，四出縱火。

translations.literal: They crossed the river and joined the Guazhou bandits, suddenly broke through the earthen encirclement, and set fires in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: They crossed the river and joined the Guazhou rebels, suddenly broke through the earthen encirclement, and set fires in all directions.

sentences.zh: 官軍戰土橋竟日，傷亡多​​。

translations.literal: The government army fought at Tuqiao all day; casualties were many.
translations.idiomatic: The government army fought at Tuqiao all day; casualties were heavy.

sentences.zh: 托明阿營壘被毀，退三汊河，又退秦家橋，幾不能軍。

translations.literal: Tuo Ming'a's camp and fortifications were destroyed; he withdrew to Sanhe River, then again to Qinjia Bridge, and was nearly unable to maintain an army.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Ming'a's camp and fortifications were destroyed; he withdrew to Sanhe River, then again to Qinjia Bridge, and was nearly unable to maintain an army.

sentences.zh: 陳金綬、雷以諴等亦退走，揚州遂陷。

translations.literal: Chen Jinshou, Lei Yixian, and others also withdrew and fled, and Yangzhou then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jinshou, Lei Yixian, and others also withdrew and fled, and Yangzhou then fell.

sentences.zh: 諸營潰散，惟德興阿猶整軍力戰。

translations.literal: The various camps collapsed and scattered; only De Xing'a still kept his army intact and fought hard.
translations.idiomatic: The various camps collapsed and scattered; only De Xing'a still kept his army intact and fought hard.

sentences.zh: 向榮遣鄧紹良渡江來援。

translations.literal: Xiang Rong sent Deng Shaoliang across the river to come to their aid.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Rong sent Deng Shaoliang across the river to come to their aid.

sentences.zh: 越十日，复揚州，而江浦亦為賊踞。

translations.literal: After ten days Yangzhou was recovered, but Jiangpu was also seized by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: After ten days Yangzhou was recovered, but Jiangpu was also seized by the rebels.

sentences.zh: 詔褫托明阿職，留營效力，尋以病歸。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Tuo Ming'a of office and ordered him to remain in camp to serve; soon afterward he returned home due to illness.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Tuo Ming'a of office and ordered him to remain in camp to serve; soon afterward he returned home due to illness.

sentences.zh: 八年，予頭等侍衛，率兵駐楊村防英兵內犯，授直隸提督，遷西安將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was given the post of first-class bodyguard, led troops to encamp at Yangcun to guard against British invasion inland, was appointed provincial commander of Zhili, and transferred to general of Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1858) he was given the post of first-class bodyguard, led troops to encamp at Yangcun to guard against British invasion inland, was appointed provincial commander of Zhili, and transferred to general of Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，以傷病乞休，四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he requested retirement due to wounds and illness; in the fourth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi (1862) he requested retirement due to wounds and illness; in the fourth year (1865) he died.

sentences.zh: 陳金綬，四川岳池人。

translations.literal: Chen Jinshou was a native of Yuechi in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jinshou was a native of Yuechi in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 從剿教匪，授把總，積功至都司。

translations.literal: He followed in suppressing the White Lotus sect bandits, was appointed platoon commander, and through accumulated merit rose to battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: He followed in suppressing the White Lotus sect bandits, was appointed platoon commander, and through accumulated merit rose to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 道光初，從征回疆，破賊於佳噶賴，功最，賜號逸勇巴圖魯，擢留壩營游擊。

translations.literal: In the early Daoguang reign he followed the campaign in the Western Regions, defeated the bandits at Jiagalai with the greatest merit, was granted the title Yiyong Batūru, and was promoted to battalion commander of the Liuba garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Daoguang reign he followed the campaign in the Western Regions, defeated the bandits at Jiagalai with the greatest merit, was granted the title Yiyong Batūru, and was promoted to battalion commander of the Liuba garrison.

sentences.zh: 十三年，直隸總督琦善調司教練，累擢督標中軍副將，琦善倚之，以堪勝總兵薦，擢天津鎮。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Zhili Governor-General Qishan transferred him to supervise training; he was repeatedly promoted to deputy commander of the governor's central army. Qishan relied on him and, recommending him as fit for regional command, promoted him to the Tianjin command.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1833) Zhili Governor-General Qishan transferred him to supervise training; he was repeatedly promoted to deputy commander of the governor's central army. Qishan relied on him and, recommending him as fit for regional command, promoted him to the Tianjin command.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，擢直隸提督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was promoted to provincial commander of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (1842) he was promoted to provincial commander of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 及琦善督師剿粵匪，率所部三千以從。

translations.literal: When Qishan commanded in suppressing the Cantonese bandits, he led three thousand of his troops to follow.
translations.idiomatic: When Qishan commanded in suppressing the Taiping rebels, he led three thousand of his troops to follow.

sentences.zh: 詔金綬為楊遇春舊部，命幫辦軍務，率兵先發。

translations.literal: An edict noted that Jinshou was an old subordinate of Yang Yuchun and ordered him to assist in military affairs and lead troops to depart first.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted that Jinshou was an old subordinate of Yang Yuchun and ordered him to assist in military affairs and lead troops to depart first.

sentences.zh: 又以其不諳文字，命勝保偕行。

translations.literal: Because he was not versed in writing, Sheng Bao was also ordered to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was not versed in writing, Sheng Bao was also ordered to accompany him.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年春，趣援江寧，偕勝保克浦口，詔責專防江北。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year of Xianfeng he was urged to relieve Jiangning; together with Sheng Bao he captured Pukou, and an edict charged him to defend the north bank exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year of Xianfeng (1853) he was urged to relieve Jiangning; together with Sheng Bao he captured Pukou, and an edict charged him to defend the north bank exclusively.

sentences.zh: 揚州陷，由六合、儀徵趨援。

translations.literal: When Yangzhou fell he hurried to relieve it by way of Liuhe and Yizheng.
translations.idiomatic: When Yangzhou fell he hurried to relieve it by way of Liuhe and Yizheng.

sentences.zh: 琦善大軍始至，合攻揚州。

translations.literal: Qishan's grand army had just arrived, and they jointly attacked Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qishan's grand army had just arrived, and they jointly attacked Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 琦善軍其北，金綬、勝保軍其西，累戰皆捷。

translations.literal: Qishan's army was on the north, Chen Jinshou's and Sheng Bao's on the west; in repeated battles they were all victorious.
translations.idiomatic: Qishan's army held the north, Chen Jinshou's and Sheng Bao's the west; in battle after battle they prevailed.

sentences.zh: 賊堅守數月不下，而瓜洲一路通江，兵少不能合圍。

translations.literal: The bandits defended stubbornly for several months without being taken, yet the Guazhou route connected to the river and there were too few troops to complete the encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held out stubbornly for months, yet the Guazhou route still connected to the river and there were too few troops to complete the encirclement.

sentences.zh: 賊分犯浦口踞之，進陷滁州，遂北竄。

translations.literal: The bandits split off to attack Pukou and seized it, then advanced and took Chuzhou, and thereafter fled north.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels split off to attack Pukou and seized it, then advanced and took Chuzhou, and thereafter fled north.

sentences.zh: 勝保率兵赴安徽應援，迭詔以孤城久抗，責攻益急。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao led troops to Anhui in relief; repeated edicts, citing the lone city's long resistance, pressed the attack ever more urgently.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao led troops to Anhui in relief; repeated edicts, citing the lone city's long resistance, pressed the attack ever more urgently.

sentences.zh: 總兵雙來奮進，緣梯登城，金綬策應。
